careTips.watering: Water 1-2 times per week, ensuring soil is moist but not waterlogged. Allow the top inch of soil to dry out between waterings.
careTips.sunlight: Requires 6-8 hours of direct sunlight daily. Place near a south-facing window or in a sunny garden spot.
careTips.fertilizing: Fertilize every 2-4 weeks during the growing season (spring and summer) with a balanced liquid fertilizer (e.g., 10-10-10).

careTips.watering: Water every 2-3 weeks, allowing soil to dry out completely between waterings. Overwatering can cause root rot.
careTips.sunlight: Needs 4-6 hours of bright, indirect sunlight or some direct morning sun. Avoid intense afternoon sun.
careTips.fertilizing: Fertilize once a month during spring and summer with a diluted cactus fertilizer (e.g., 5-10-10).

careTips.watering: Water when the top 1-2 inches of soil feel dry, typically every 7-10 days. Adjust based on humidity and season.
careTips.sunlight: Prefers bright, indirect light. Can tolerate low light but may grow slower.
careTips.fertilizing: Fertilize every 4-6 weeks during spring and summer with a nitrogen-rich fertilizer (e.g., 20-10-10).

careTips.watering: Water when the soil feels dry to the touch, about 1-2 times per week. Ensure good drainage to prevent soggy roots.
careTips.sunlight: Requires 6 hours of direct sunlight daily. A sunny windowsill or outdoor garden is ideal.
careTips.fertilizing: Fertilize every 2-3 weeks during the growing season with an organic fertilizer or compost tea.
